day_shape: 56 items: fire on a vessel in the Strait of Hormuz as CENTCOM claims 100 ships redirected in 60-day 'steel wall' blockade, Trump blames Iran for Saudi East-West pipeline strike, heavy IRGC/IRIB messaging on Hormuz control and a 313,000-person 'Janfada' mobilisation, Iran-Gulf talks set for Monday in Oman.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz maritime confrontation
threads.summary: UK Maritime Trade Operations reported a fire on a vessel previously attacked in the Strait of Hormuz, while CENTCOM said US forces have redirected 100 commercial vessels in 60 days under a resumed 'steel wall' blockade. IRIB and Defa Press framed Iran's Hormuz posture as a physical and economic blockade, with IRGC Tehran commander Hasanzadeh claiming Iran holds a 'powerful grip' on the strait.

threads.label: Saudi pipeline strike and Gulf diplomacy
threads.summary: Trump said Iran was probably responsible for the drone attack that shut Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline, while Iran-backed Iraqi factions denied involvement after Baghdad dismissed a commander and closed Iran border crossings. Iran and Gulf states are scheduled to meet Monday in Oman to discuss the Strait of Hormuz, with no signed agreement expected.

threads.label: IRGC mobilisation and post-war messaging
threads.summary: Defa Press said 1,000 'Janfada' resistance battalions are being organised and IRGC Tehran commander Hasanzadeh reported over 313,000 registrants for the drill, while Khamenei's office posted that the 'resistance front' delivered victories in the 'third imposed war'. A Tehran court held its first hearing on claims by families of '12-day war' martyrs.

threads.label: Domestic pressure inside Iran
threads.summary: Iran International reported Iranians buying bread on credit and queuing for chicken scraps, elite schools charging billions of rials while poorer students go without, and at least 29 executions of January protest detainees including public hangings. A 33-year-old Bandar Abbas blogger was sentenced to death on security charges, and Anthropic said Iranian security units used its Claude model to surveil dissidents.

threads.label: Yemen and Bab el-Mandeb claims
threads.summary: Defa Press claimed Ansarallah has taken 'undisputed control' of Bab el-Mandeb after capturing Perim island, while IRIB carried an expert citing 5,000 Ansarallah fighters resisting 50,000 US- and Israeli-equipped forces. The Jerusalem Post reported Yemeni battalions in Mocha were largely unprepared for a Houthi takeover, with rosters padded by 'ghost names'.

events.title_en: Iran's geo-economic power in the Strait of Hormuz; from physical blockade to economic blockade
events.summary_en: Iran's geo-economic power in the Strait of Hormuz; from physical blockade to economic blockade. events.title_en: The wrestler and fruit-seller and an embrace that reached paradise
events.summary_en: The wrestler and fruit-seller and an embrace that reached paradise. At 3 am on the sixth of Farvardin 1405, the house of the Maleki family in Haft-oun neighbourhood in Isfahan came under attack. A few minutes later, the house no longer existed; the father of the family and his two young children were buried under the rubble, and the mother, despite her injuries, kept searching for her child. This, however, was not the end. Two months later, the mother too passed away; a woman whom her relatives say could not bear the absence of her husband and two children. Hossein Maleki was 35 years old and worked as a fruit seller in Haft-oun neighbourhood. For many residents of the neighbourhood, however, he was more than just a merchant. Residents of Haft-oun remember Hossein Maleki as a man who spent his days behind the fruit stall...

events.title_en: Remains of 6-month-old infant identified in Ramsar archaeological excavations
events.summary_en: Remains of 6-month-old infant identified in Ramsar archaeological excavations. In recent days, in layers corresponding to the upper part of the Bronze Age, the skeletal remains of a baby boy approximately 6 months old were identified. Examination of this infant's dental remains shows that at the time of death, his teeth were freshly erupting from the gums. Based on the condition of the bones and physical state of this child, the possibility of some disease or disorder is raised, but to confirm this and obtain an accurate diagnosis, further specialist studies are necessary.
